note: CSS migration ratchet (css-migration-plan.md). These numbers may only go DOWN. A rise is a regression; a fall means this file is stale and must be lowered in the same commit — the intention is that progress can never be spent silently. `info` is context and is not compared: a legitimate feature adds rules and lines, so those are not ratcheted. One deliberate raise is recorded here: Phase 2 split `panel.css` into the family sheets, which made the legacy classes part of the owned sheets, so `unprefixedClasses` jumped from 35 to 180 in that commit — Phase 3 brings it back down. `panelCssLines` is now 0 because `panel.css` no longer exists, and Phase 3 has begun: the toast family renamed to `ts-`, so `unprefixedClasses` is 178. Phase 5 then took the last four non-zero §5.3 counters to zero in one pass — the 60 `!important`s, the 7 `:has()` stacking workarounds (two of which were dead) and the one over-depth selector — which is why `important`, `deepSelectors` and `hasSelectors` are 0. `colourLiterals` also fell 65 → 63: the two deleted dead `:has()` rules carried an `rgba()` each. Phase 3 then renamed the shared `ut-` family — the base utilities (`container`, `creator`, `scrollable-content`, `empty-state`) plus the state modifiers every family shares (`active`, `selected`, `dragging`, `drag-over`, `pinned`, `expanded`, `disabled`, `rotated`, `hidden`, `grid-view`, `sort-active`, `panel-closing`, `show`, `hide`) — 18 names, which took `unprefixedClasses` to 160; then the `dl-` dialog family (25 names) took it to 135.
